title: Access
description: Every way into this gateway, in one place: accounts, OAuth sessions, API keys and registered clients.
loadError: Could not determine your role. Retry.
usersDescription: Every account that exists in this deployment, newest first. The three counts are live access paths: signed-in sessions, unexpired OAuth tokens, and active API keys.
revokeConfirmDescription: Signs out every session, deletes every OAuth access token and pending authorization code, and deactivates every API key this account owns. The account itself is KEPT, along with its record of who it was — it can sign in again. Use Delete to remove it permanently.
revokeSuccess: Revoked {{sessions}} sessions, {{tokens}} OAuth tokens, {{codes}} authorization codes; deactivated {{keys}} API keys.
deleteConfirmDescription: Permanently deletes the account and everything that references it: sessions, the stored password, API keys, OAuth tokens and codes, the Microsoft 365 token, and any MCP servers, namespaces and endpoints this user owns privately. Shared (public) resources are not affected. This cannot be undone.
tokensDescription: Unexpired access tokens — who is connected through an OAuth client right now. Token values are never shown; revoke by deleting the client or revoking the user.
apiKeysDescription: Every API key across all users. Only a non-reversible prefix is shown. Mint, rename and revoke keys on the API Keys page.
clientsDescription: Clients that may complete an authorization flow against this gateway. Register and delete clients on the OAuth Clients page.
